confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Japanese price levels; no menus, listings, or booking pages were checked, and web search was not used for city prices. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than lodging, which varies with season and weekend demand. Cocktail and wine are direct estimates cross-checked against beer (about 1.5x and 1.2x). The FX row comes from search summaries citing the 15 Oct 2026 RBA fix; other search checks reached only an older RBA copy (March 2026), so confirm it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Japanese regional tourist-city basis: prices benchmarked to Kyoto and Osaka levels and adjusted down for a smaller visitor base, then cross-checked against Japan-wide chain price points.
